Summary
About Northstar Law Group

Northstar Law Group is a U.S.-based immigration law firm dedicated to providing compassionate and high-quality legal services, especially in family-based and humanitarian immigration. Our diverse, global team thrives on collaboration, adaptability, responsibility, and empathy — the CARE values that guide everything we do.

We rely heavily on data dashboards to manage performance, track caseloads, and make strategic decisions. We’re now looking for a tech-savvy, detail-oriented Spreadsheet Automation Specialist to help us streamline and automate our MS Excel and Google Sheets dashboards — transforming manual reporting into smart, automated systems that empower our team.

What You’ll Do

Audit & Optimize Systems

Review existing Excel, Google Sheets, Airtable, and Smartsheet dashboards for inefficiencies, redundancies, and bottlenecks

Recommend improvements to streamline workflows and ensure accuracy across all platforms

Build & Automate Workflows

Design and optimize automated data pipelines, advanced formulas, conditional logic, and reusable templates

Leverage Airtable automations, Smartsheet workflows, and integrations to reduce manual processes

Create Dynamic Dashboards

Develop user-friendly dashboards with interactive charts, summaries, and drill-down capabilities

Implement role-based or team-based views to enhance usability and decision-making

Implement Error-Proof Systems

Use scripts, macros, and automation logic (e.g., Excel VBA, Google Apps Script, Airtable scripting) to minimize human error

Apply rigorous data validation and error-handling mechanisms across platforms

Integrate Tools & Data Sources

Connect spreadsheets and no-code platforms (Airtable, Smartsheet) with external tools via APIs, Zapier, Make (Integromat), or native connectors

Ensure smooth data flow between CRMs, project management systems, and reporting dashboards

Document & Train

Maintain clear documentation of all automation processes, workflows, and integration logic

Provide training and support so that internal teams can easily adopt and maintain the systems

What We’re Looking For

Proven experience building and automating complex spreadsheets in Excel and Google Sheets

Strong skills in advanced formulas, pivot tables, conditional formatting, and data validation

Hands-on experience with Excel VBA and/or Google Apps Script

Specialization in Airtable, Smartsheet, and other similar workflow automation and collaboration tools

Familiarity with data visualization best practices across multiple platforms

Ability to integrate and optimize workflows between spreadsheets and no-code tools (e.g., Airtable automations, Smartsheet dashboards, Zapier/Make integrations)

Strong attention to detail and problem-solving mindset

Ability to deliver clean, user-friendly dashboards and reports on time
